text: Excellent service. The dentist was very gentle. I had my wisdom tooth extracted; it was painless and bruised. The price was reasonable, and they accept social security insurance. The clinic is located on the main road near the entrance of Soi 54. You can park at Market 61 and cross the road.
Always have good experience with this clinic... Highly recommended...

I came to have my wisdom teeth extracted with the doctor. He has a very gentle hand. You could say it didn't hurt at all. He also had a gentle hand when scraping away tartar. He was meticulous in every detail. My teeth were clean and perfectly set. They weren't chipped like they were at other places. I was very impressed. I would rank this clinic number 1.
